# Features:
## - Fuel injection regulator when traveling between 5 planets. Maximum speed setting 
## - Percentage based belt regulator
## - Automatically crafts legendary quality modules tier 3 (You only need Legendary holmium plates which you can easily get with electromagnetic plant upcycler)
## - Automatically gets rid of Legendary ice
## - 58 cargo bays x 20 = 1160 Inventory size capacity
## - Can travel to Aquilo if necessary with rockets

You NEED at least 4-6 legendary chemical plants and 2 legendary beacons for the fuel economy OR 3720 thruster fuel/oxidizer per second. If you aim for higher efficiencies you don't need nearly as much it's so it's also possible with 2000~ fuel/oxidizer. Rest of the legendary buildings are preference. The foundry beacons are quite helpful.
